gen-gf-turret-road-gf-electrolize: Electrolize has a jaw-like c that gapes open, giving the text a crisp, modern bite. Turret Road's flat, single-weight heading looks almost drawn with one pen, and it grows stiff if shrunk down.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-elms-sans: Elms Sans draws its lines like a ballpoint, light and pressureless, with s shapes you can see through. Turret Road throws round, parenthesis-like forms and a commanding bulk up top, while the sans below simply keeps things moving.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-encode-sans: Turret Road's tubular strokes look like bent copper pipe, bold and rounded and sure of themselves in big, short lines. Encode Sans keeps its c clearly apart from o.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-encode-sans-expand: Plain, unmodulated outlines give Turret Road its commanding, pipe-bent look, with round forms like open parentheses. And Encode Sans Expanded spreads its approachable c shapes wide, though blown up large it would drown the heading.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-encode-sans-sc: Commanding is how Turret Road lands, its crossbars as fat as the stems they join. Encode Sans SC settles into a shallow terminal curl and a wide gap, so give it a comfortable size to breathe.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-encode-sans-semi-c: Turret Road's stroke ends are as wide as the middle, so every round form lands like a solid rod. Encode Sans Semi Condensed brings approachable openings, notably on the s, and deserves a size generous enough to show them.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-encode-sans-semi-e: Turret Road bends like constant-width wire, all round parenthesis forms. Encode Sans Semi Expanded leaves its rounded letters open and modern beneath, so the heavy wire up top gets a light, neutral partner to lean on.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-exo: Approachable describes Exo, with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp. Turret Road, with a pipe-like body to every stroke, takes the commanding lead above while Exo quietly does the explaining underneath.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-exo-2: Exo 2 keeps curves full of daylight, clean and professional. Turret Road bends like a paperclip with no thick-thin shifts, so it leads boldly while Exo 2 fills in the detail beneath.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-faculty-glyphic: Turret Road holds a constant stroke width, like bent pipe, with round parenthesis forms that feel bold and commanding. And Faculty Glyphic keeps clear openings in its rounded letters, so a longer passage reads smoothly and modern.
